description: Update properties for an existing category or category group. Provide at least one updatable property. For category groups, supplying children replaces the group's full child list. Cannot be used to convert between category and category group.

archived.description: Whether the category should be archived.

archived_at.description: ISO 8601 datetime of when the category was archived. Send null to clear it.

categoryId.description: Id of the category or category group to update.

children.description: Only valid for category groups. Replaces the group's full children list. Existing category IDs (numbers), existing category objects (their id is used), and/or new sub-category names (strings). Categories must already exist and cannot be category groups; ones already in another group are moved.

collapsed.description: If true, the category group is collapsed in the Lunch Money app. Usually set by the user in the app, but settable via the API.

description.description: New description. Up to 200 characters. Send null to clear the existing description.

exclude_from_budget.description: Whether transactions in this category should be excluded from budgets.

exclude_from_totals.description: Whether transactions in this category should be excluded from calculated totals.

group_id.description: Move this category into the specified category group, or null to remove from any group. Not applicable to category groups.

is_group.description: Tolerated by the API but cannot be changed. Only send it to confirm the current type; a different value returns an error. Does not count as an update on its own.

is_income.description: Whether transactions in this category should be treated as income.

name.description: New name. 1-100 characters. Must not match an existing category or category group name.

name: update_category
